item.title: GDT Exec: Channel Can Benefit From Nvidia’s AI Financing Boom—But Hurdles Persist
item.description: Chris Kapusta, an executive at Softcat-owned GDT, explains to CRN how Nvidia’s AI financing boom can benefit the channel, but says solution providers, including his company, are grappling with the global components crunch and growing U.S. data center backlash.

item.title: Feds Arrest Solution Provider Owner In Alleged $300M GPU Server Smuggling Scheme
item.description: Greg Lui, owner of solution provider EarthMade Computer, was arrested for allegedly smuggling $300 million-plus in servers with U.S.-based GPUs to China.
